title: Nightingale demo: what actually ran

docs.scope: Actual Wiki native Google Docs Unslop task
docs.coverage_note: Unsupported rich-text blocks were preserved without processing; this is not a claim that every paragraph was transformed.

slides.scope: Actual Wiki native Google Slides Unslop task, following native conversion of the authored PowerPoint
slides.coverage_note: 15 unsupported rich-text targets were preserved without processing. The server still marks the result as requiring review.

spreadsheets.scope: Separate source-bound shared Unslop engine passes, not a Wiki spreadsheet endpoint or UI feature
spreadsheets.coverage_note: Only six authored prose cells were eligible; labels, data, formulas, sources and chart structures were excluded. The checked copy retains the original source's label-spacing imperfections.

powerpoint_source_attempt.reason: The source PowerPoint contains a native chart data workbook under ppt/embeddings/, which the current package guard does not support.
powerpoint_source_attempt.successful_followup: Google's native Slides conversion, then the actual Slides Unslop task above, followed by a real PowerPoint export.

html_companion.scope: HTML rendering of the actual Docs result, not another Unslop run
html_companion.preview_transport: Checksum-verified JSON envelope; the HTML file remains available in Drive.

read_only: Demo previews use public read-only provider views. No document processing or private Wiki API calls run when visiting the demo.
